title: Mount sub-instances' declared git sources
description: Lays down every sub-instance's declared git source (core's `source: {kind: "git", repository, ref, path}`) at <name>-source/, the way a remote layer is mounted: at the pinned 40-character commit, verified after checkout, with `origin` recorded for provenance, git-ignored and never committed, and never over a directory that is not that commit. Used for iHRIS/iHRIS (src/ihris5/ihris5.json), which cat-harness's mount:remote cannot take because it has no declaration of its own. --check needs no network; --print <name> prints the source's IG directory.
